text: Helping children move, play and learn with confidence

Sensphere provides occupational therapy assessments and therapy for children and young people, working closely alongside families and schools to build the everyday skills that matter most — at home, in the classroom and in the playground.

sections.label: Support built around the child, not the diagnosis
text: Support built around the child, not the diagnosis
Every child develops differently. We look at the whole picture — sensory, motor, emotional and environmental — to understand what's making everyday tasks harder, and what will make them easier.
Younger Children
Support with feeding, dressing, play skills, coordination and early sensory regulation for children in nursery and early primary years.
School-Age Children
Handwriting, pencil grip, organisation, PE and playground participation, and strategies for coping with busy classroom environments.
Young People
Support with sensory overwhelm, executive function, independence skills and the transition to secondary school or college life.
Neurodivergent Children
Tailored approaches for children who are autistic, have ADHD, DCD/dyspraxia, or sensory processing differences.
Families
Practical strategies parents and carers can use at home, plus guidance on routines, transitions and managing big emotions.
Schools & Settings
Consultation, classroom observation and staff training to help schools put reasonable adjustments in place with confidence.
Who We Help

sections.label: Assessment and therapy, tailored to each child
text: Assessment and therapy, tailored to each child
From a first assessment through to ongoing therapy and school liaison, we work in a way that fits around your family and your child's needs.
Occupational Therapy Assessment
A thorough, play-based assessment of your child's sensory processing, motor skills, self-care and daily functioning, using standardised tools alongside clinical observation.
Sensory Processing Support
Identifying sensory sensitivities or seeking behaviours and building a sensory diet and environment strategies to support regulation across settings.
1:1 Therapy Programmes
Individualised, goal-led therapy sessions in clinic, at home or in school, working on fine motor, gross motor, self-care and regulation skills.
Handwriting & Fine Motor Groups
Small-group and individual sessions to build pencil control, letter formation, scissor skills and hand strength.
School Observations & Liaison
On-site classroom observations, teacher consultation, and written recommendations that schools can put into practice straight away.
EHCP & SEND Report Writing
Detailed OT reports to support Education, Health and Care Plan applications, tribunal evidence and annual reviews.
Parent & Carer Coaching
Guided sessions to help you carry therapy strategies into daily routines — mealtimes, mornings, homework and beyond.
Staff Training & CPD
Practical training for teachers and teaching assistants on sensory processing, regulation strategies and inclusive classroom design.

sections.label: How working with Sensphere works
text: How working with Sensphere works
A clear, unhurried process so you always know what happens next.
Initial Enquiry
Tell us about your child and what you're noticing. We'll arrange a free 15-minute call to check we're the right fit.
Assessment
A comprehensive OT assessment, drawing on standardised measures, observation, and conversations with you and, where relevant, school staff.
Feedback & Plan
We share findings in plain language, agree goals together, and set out a therapy or support plan with clear next steps.
Therapy & Review
Ongoing sessions in clinic, home or school, with regular reviews so the plan keeps pace with your child's progress.

sections.label: A therapy partner your SENCo can rely on
text: A therapy partner your SENCo can rely on
We work directly with schools and nurseries to support pupils with sensory and motor needs — from a single consultation to an ongoing, embedded partnership across the school year.
✓ Classroom and playground observations, with written recommendations SENCos and teachers can act on immediately.
✓ Whole-staff or small-group CPD on sensory processing, regulation and inclusive classroom practice.
✓ Individual pupil support plans that align with EHCP outcomes and annual review targets.
✓ Flexible visit arrangements, including termly block bookings for settings supporting several pupils.

sections.label: Common questions from families
text: Common questions from families

No. Many families come to us before any formal diagnosis, simply because they've noticed their child is struggling with a skill, sensory experience or routine. Assessment can also help build the picture if a diagnostic pathway is being considered.
Wherever works best for your child — our clinic, your home, or their school or nursery setting. Many families use a mix, particularly during assessment.
Yes, with your consent. We regularly liaise with teachers and SENCos, carry out classroom observations, and provide written recommendations schools can implement straight away.
A full initial assessment typically involves one to two sessions with your child plus a parent consultation, with a written report following within two to three weeks.
Yes. We regularly write detailed OT reports to support EHCP needs assessments, annual reviews and, where necessary, tribunal evidence.
We offer in-person visits across the surrounding region and online consultations, school liaison calls and parent coaching sessions UK-wide.
